timing.included: validation, RSS preparation, IBSS, posterior/credible-set summaries
timing.excluded: imports, input reads, explicit garbage collection, output serialization

memory.full_process: Fresh backend/case process VmHWM or ru_maxrss, captured before output export
memory.sampled: Current RSS baseline after imports/inputs/GC; sample fit-phase RSS at target2ms through retained result; increment = sampled peak minus current baseline, lower bound

sampled_memory.definition: Current RSS after imports, inputs and GC; sampled until a returned fit is retained, before export. Increment = sampled peak minus this current-RSS baseline.
sampled_memory.limitation: Sampled peak and increment are lower bounds; short allocation spikes between samples can be missed. Handshake waits are outside timing mode. Full-process HWM is a separate backend metric.

caveats: These are complete public calls for this fixed panel, not optimization attribution.
Controlled deterministic AR(1) dense inputs vary p with fixed model settings; they are computational measurement fixtures.
Timing medians use seven warm retained calls, with a single warmup excluded.
Memory uses a separate fresh process per case/backend. Full HWM includes interpreter, dependencies, input, temporary arrays and result.
Sampled increments subtract current prefit RSS, never historical HWM. Peaks between samples can be missed.
Hard process address space is 16 GiB; aggregate 48 GiB and host-pressure monitoring are best effort, not whole-host guarantees.
